title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Palisades Nuclear Power Plant [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:             Ardeth/Carol
To:               Marlayna Doell
Subject:          [External_Sender] Palisades Nuclear Power plant
Date:             Thursday, October 8, 2026 3:50:50 PM


Dear Ms. Doell,

I am writing to express my opposition to the reopening of Palisades Nuclear Power Plant.
Sitting on the shores of Lake MI this is a disaster waiting to happen.
Given Holtec’s failures to date and probable future failures the NRC should terminate the
restart attempt and require closure and clean up.
I speak for many citizens in MI where I was born and will retire to on a few years.
Thank you!
Sincerely,
Carol Gilbert, OP
Grand Rapids MI Dominican Sister
503 Rock Creek Church Rd. NW
Washington, DC 20010
